name: studyluma
description: StudyLuma monorepo. The root only holds tooling; the code lives in packages/, the Development instance in dev/. Installed only as part of the planning workspace (../package.json).

scripts.check: bun run manifest && bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:pack && bun run typecheck:tooling && bun run format:check && bun run test:tooling && bun run --filter './packages/*' check && bun run --filter studyluma-dev check
